activity_statements.statement: operates scheduled passenger air service to up to 275 destinations in 50 countries for nearly 200 million travelers annually
runs up to 4,000 daily flight departures across its domestic and international network
operates Delta Sky Club airport lounges for premium members and credit card holders
sells advertising inventory to brands seeking to reach a high-income frequent-traveler audience
operates a frequent-flyer loyalty program generating revenue through miles sold to co-brand credit card and airline partners
employs roughly 100,000 people across flight operations, cabin service, ground handling, maintenance, and corporate functions

name_reality_gap: none — Delta Air Lines is clearly identified as an airline. However, the loyalty program and co-brand credit card partnership represent a meaningful financial segment not visible from the brand name alone.
extraction_notes: About page provided fleet size, destinations, and headcount. Loyalty and cargo revenue detail from industry knowledge of Delta's 2024 financial structure; no 10-K segment data retrieved directly.
